{{Top}}
'''Siege platform''' was a designation for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] starships. Members of [[Battle Station Command/Legends|Battle Station Command]] served aboard them.<ref name="DESB">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==History==
One type of siege platform was [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar's]] [[Torpedo Sphere/Legends|Torpedo Sphere]].<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Titus Klev]] served on many siege platforms and [[Space station/Legends|space stations]], earning recognition for hampering a sabotage attempt at the [[Siege of Wann Tsir]].<ref name="DESB" />
